# Emeric Ferreira Dos Santos — AI Engineer, Full-Stack Builder & UX/UI Designer (Geneva, Switzerland)

> Emeric Ferreira Dos Santos (Emeric FDS) is an AI Engineer, Full-Stack Software Builder, and UX/UI Designer based in Geneva (1227 Les Acacias), Switzerland, holding a permanent **Swiss C Residence Permit (Permis C)** and speaking **4 languages** (French Native, Portuguese C2, English B2, Spanish B2). Creator of **[Obvious Tool (obvioustool.com)](https://obvioustool.com/)**, *PhotoLift* (Rust/Tauri), *CVite* (NLP), *Smart Bucket* (ML), and *GhostLink* (AES-256); Digital Advisor, Trainer & Internal App UX/UI Designer at **Declix (Geneva)**; and shipped commercial console Level/UX/UI Designer (*Pure Mahjong* on Nintendo Switch — 1,000+ levels).

## Core Engineering & UX/UI Capabilities
1. **AI Agents, LLMs & Applied ML**: Autonomous multi-step agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), unstructured document extraction (PDF/OCR/NLP), sentiment & market regime classification, Computer Vision (YOLOv8, OpenCV), privacy-first local AI modules (Python, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
2. **Full-Stack Web & Native Desktop Software**: End-to-end product architecture using TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Next.js, Vite, Node.js, native cross-platform desktop apps with **Rust & Tauri**, C# application logic, and client-side cryptography (**AES-256 WebCrypto**).
3. **UX/UI Design, Information Architecture & 3D Systems**: Concrete field experience in interface design and prototyping, user testing, information architecture, user navigation schemas, storyboards, and ergonomic simplification—plus 3D engines (**Unity**, **Unreal Engine**) and shipped **Nintendo Switch** production.

## Flagship Products & Realizations
- **[Obvious Tool](https://obvioustool.com/) (2025 — Live AI & Developer Suite)**: Unified web & desktop workspace consolidating 50+ developer/creative utilities with embedded AI modules (paraphrasing, grammar correction, multilingual translation) running locally, ad-free, and privacy-first.
- **PhotoLift (2026 — Native Rust & Tauri Desktop App)**: High-throughput studio photography application built with Rust, Tauri, and React. Automates session sorting, color grading, and batch compression (**88% JPEG size reduction**, ~6-minute per-client workflow). ([Projects](https://emericfds.com/#projects-section))
- **CVite (2025 — Applied NLP & Document AI)**: AI resume platform parsing unstructured PDF/image resumes via NLP into customizable real-time editorial layouts. ([Projects](https://emericfds.com/#projects-section))
- **Smart Bucket (2025 — Quantitative ML & FinTech)**: Autonomous digital asset portfolio engine combining 24/7 market regime detection, NLP sentiment analysis, and multi-asset rebalancing across BTC, ETH, SOL, and TON. ([Projects](https://emericfds.com/#projects-section))
- **GhostLink (2024 — Zero-Knowledge Web Security)**: Serverless secret and file sharing web app using 100% client-side AES-256 encryption where the URL hash carries the encrypted payload. ([Projects](https://emericfds.com/#projects-section))
- **[Pure Mahjong](https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Pure-Mahjong-1579159.html) (2020 — Commercial Nintendo Switch Release)**: Commercial puzzle game published worldwide on Nintendo Switch featuring **1,000+ handcrafted levels** across the 24 Chinese solar calendar events.
